track.title: ProgressionData and EconomyData archaeology
track.array_policy: All arrays are authored in deterministic order by identifier, address, or lifecycle order.

normalization.ProgressionData: Analytical projection; no original ProgressionData symbol was recovered.
normalization.EconomyData: Analytical projection; no original EconomyData symbol was recovered. cScenarioDataEconomy is the closest named scenario type; global economy state is distributed across cEmpire, cMission, cPlayerInventory, cSpaceInventoryItem, cSpaceTrading, cCommodityNode, and cCollectableItems.

statuses.VERIFIED: Directly present in a pinned export, SDK layout, function inventory, or static call edge; not runtime-observed.
statuses.INFERRED: Bounded cross-artifact model or semantic interpretation.

ghidra.reason: The headless bridge had no open SporeApp.exe program; GUI-only program-open tooling was unavailable.
ghidra.use: Pinned exports, SDK XML, read-only KG projections, committed research, and current source.

evidence_base.claims: Pinned binary identity, x86:LE:32 metadata, 58,757 function rows, 2,035 structures, 25,546 fields, and 478 SDK decompilation files.

Original names, offsets, enum values, vtable slots, and function prototypes; SDK commit cbf9206b9a823f0911cd9be0217104a49d72380b, XML SHA-256 5d894677c1835082da0392e8b794f3c93a0251733898c3c5b81cf7945f458f09.
Structure sizes/fields, function addresses/sizes, and imported SDK address anchors.
223,704 caller/callee/reference edges; structural counts are not runtime reachability.
12 progression-economy rows in a 2,149-function gameplay population; artifact triage-v6 preserves triage-v5 row metadata.
Read-only node, field, triage, and xref queries; no KG rows changed.
Empire, relationship, space economy, inventory, mission, scenario-adjacent, serialization, and OpenSpore cross-link dossiers.
PropertyList, ClassSerializer, cSavedGameHeader, GameLoadParameters, cCellSerializableData, and no-runtime-round-trip limits.
High-fan-in manager accessors, SpacePlayerData cache, cEmpire political-ID seam, and intentionally unresolved manager owners.
Selected call shapes and bounded memory operations only; damaged signatures, tail aliases, and dead SDK anchors are not promoted.

contradictions.observation: No original symbols named ProgressionData or EconomyData were recovered; cScenarioDataEconomy is only a scenario-specific named type.
contradictions.resolution: Treat ProgressionData/EconomyData as analytical projections and preserve exact source types separately.

contradictions.observation: The SDK field mEvolutionPoints is at +0x28, but Get/Set/AddEvolutionPoints bodies read/write DAT_0169e398.
contradictions.resolution: Keep field layout and observed global-slot mechanics separate; do not claim a direct field access or one object owner.

contradictions.observation: OpenSpore CellSim increments growMeter, while original structures expose mEvolutionPoints and mEvolutionPointsSpent.
contradictions.resolution: Do not map growMeter to either original field without a runtime or writer trace.

contradictions.observation: AddUnlockableItem and AddUnlockableItemFromProp populate the configuration registry; no writer for status/list unlock state was recovered.
contradictions.resolution: Treat these functions as registration/derivation, not proof of a successful unlock.

contradictions.observation: Several progression/economy SDK addresses are dead anchors or containing-function repairs, including difficulty, mission, scenario, inventory, and trade methods.
contradictions.resolution: Use repaired containing addresses with status INFERRED; do not publish SDK anchors as exact function bodies.

contradictions.observation: cGamePersistenceManager exposes LoadGame in the vtable, while no named SaveGame function was found.
contradictions.resolution: Do not infer absence of saving from absent symbol; serializer and stream paths may be unnamed or virtual.

contradictions.observation: SDK header and imported Ghidra XML disagree on Property size/field offsets.
contradictions.resolution: Do not use either layout as a binary wire contract without body/fixture evidence.

contradictions.observation: Committed original-process evidence is negative/inconclusive for Cell Stage; no economy or progression transition is observed.
contradictions.resolution: All semantic claims remain static projections; no replacement status promotion is justified.

reconstruction_packages.name: progression-economy-manager-roots
reconstruction_packages.why: The unnamed/high-fan-in manager roots gate cross-stage state, identity, economy, and persistence.
reconstruction_packages.stop: Do not assign unnamed accessor owners or implement semantics until setters, reset behavior, and persistence boundaries are characterized.

reconstruction_packages.name: unlock-registry
reconstruction_packages.why: The schema cleanly separates unlock eligibility, points, status, unlocked list, and tool candidates.
reconstruction_packages.stop: Find status/list/point mutation and a fixture-backed config/unlock round trip before promotion.

reconstruction_packages.name: creature-progression
reconstruction_packages.why: Evolution point read/set/add/cap/action mechanics are directly bounded.
reconstruction_packages.stop: Recover the level-up/ability consumer and cross-stage synchronization; do not merge with growMeter.

reconstruction_packages.name: inventory-and-space-economy
reconstruction_packages.why: Counts, costs, item identity, cargo, rare resources, stores, and commodity depletion form a coherent static economy seam.
reconstruction_packages.stop: Recover price/stock/cargo/money/depletion formulas and inventory insertion/removal before implementation.

reconstruction_packages.name: mission-reward-state-machine
reconstruction_packages.why: Mission states, costs, rewards, unlocks, target IDs, and communication are named, but transition order is incomplete.
reconstruction_packages.stop: Recover accept/complete/fail callbacks and payout/debit order; no synthetic economy rule before that.

reconstruction_packages.name: scenario-economy
reconstruction_packages.why: The named scenario economy is the most direct recovered economy object, but its indices and event rules are unknown.
reconstruction_packages.stop: Map value indices, point sink/source, goal producer, and resource read/write semantics.

reconstruction_packages.name: property-and-save-load
reconstruction_packages.why: Property/serializer/persistence surfaces are prerequisites for any faithful state replacement.
reconstruction_packages.stop: Create a clean-room property fixture and establish exact codec/version behavior before attaching subsystem serializers.
